responsibility: Implements s390x ABI classification for arguments and returns, widening scalar values up to 64 bits, using direct floating-point or integer register coercions for eligible small aggregates, making larger cases indirect, and preserving Linux GNU-like zero-sized argument passing behavior.
same_name_distinction: Unlike `asm/s390x.rs`, this s390x file classifies function arguments and returns—widening scalars, directly coercing some small aggregates, and preserving Linux GNU-like ZST passing—rather than defining inline-assembly register kinds, `%`-prefixed emission, and vector/floating-point overlap.
